name: ai-maestro-visual-communicator-plugin
description: Generate interactive HTML pages — diagrams, diff reviews, plan reviews, slide decks, data tables, and v2 modal-comment agent reports. Every page sends the user's selection (or per-element comment thread) back to the agent.

cpv._intentional_pipeline_drift_rationale: Per canonical-pipeline-migration step 10b (doctor report 20260519_101728+0200-canonical-pipeline-upgrade.md) and step 13 (CHECK-15 ruff UP037 fix): the 8 files listed in `_intentional_pipeline_drift_files` carry INTENTIONAL drift vs the CPV canon. Most are STRICTLY above canon (additional SHA-pins, timeout-minutes, env-sanitization, schema fixes). publish.py is mixed: above on atomic-push + 3-manifest lockstep + dev-browser soft-pass; selective merge of canon's Gates 0/5 + idempotent commit/tag, not full overlay. .markdownlint.json keeps local _comment + MD012 disable. scripts/cpv_network_resilience.py has the string-quoted-annotation removed (UP037: redundant under `from __future__ import annotations`); the canonical CPV version still has the string form. When CPV implements the `allow_pipeline_drift` allowlist mechanism (referenced in the validator's recommendation text but not yet active in v2.94.0), this list can be promoted to a functional `allow_pipeline_drift` field. See per-step commit messages for the per-file rationale.
cpv._intentional_validator_false_positives_r: Documented validator false-positives. Each entry is a per-finding allowlist of (file, level, message_substring) consumed by publish.py::_gate_validate(). Sources: (1) step 12 — 4 `Possible broken backtick path` WARNINGs against `skills/amvcp-self-debug-rules/SKILL.md` for paths that DO exist on disk; tracked as candidate upstream bug #30. (2) step 14 — 1 MAJOR `Reference to non-existent skill 'amvcp-wf-'` against `skills/amvcp-wireframe/SKILL.md`; tracked as upstream bug #27 (HEAD-list parser empty-suffix). The matcher in `_gate_validate()` allowlists findings whose (file, level) tuple matches and whose message CONTAINS the listed `message_substring`. Findings outside this allowlist still block G3 normally. ALL allowlisted entries cite the upstream bug they correspond to in the `upstream_bug` field — when CPV ships the fix, the entry can be removed.
